if(WIN32)
  add_library(StackWalker STATIC)
  target_folder(StackWalker ${FOLDER_EXTERNAL})
  set(STACKWALKER_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/3rd party/stackwalker")
  target_include_directories(StackWalker INTERFACE "${STACKWALKER_DIR}/include")
else()
  add_library(StackWalker INTERFACE)
  target_folder(StackWalker ${FOLDER_EXTERNAL})
endif()
